question: Do arts. 124 and 126 reach voluntary interruption of pregnancy in the first trimester?

readings.description: Yes. The types apply at every gestational age. The only exceptions are art. 128 and the ADPF 54 read-down for anencephaly (M-sweep-b-01).

citations.cite: STF ADPF 54 (Tribunal Pleno, 12.4.2012), as reproduced by TJDFT

readings.description: No. Arts. 124–126 read in conformity with the Constitution exclude voluntary interruption in the first trimester. This is the reading of HC 124.306, a 1ª Turma decision that bound only that case, and the object of the pending ADPF 442.

citations.cite: STF HC 124306, Primeira Turma, julgado em 09-08-2016 (inter partes)
STF ADPF 442 (pending; destaque by Min. Gilmar Mendes, October 2025)

note: The text is binding law. HC 124.306 has no erga omnes effect, and ADPF 442 is undecided (M-sweep-b-03 is the currency risk). If ADPF 442 is decided for the petitioner, this fork becomes a rule-version arm.

question: Does Lei 8.072/1990 art. 9º (plus half when the victim is in an art. 224 situation) still operate after Lei 12.015/2009 revoked art. 224?

readings.description: No. Its only trigger is 'qualquer das hipóteses referidas no art. 224', and art. 224 has not existed since 10.8.2009. The increase has no operative condition.

citations.cite: Lei 12.015/2009 art. 7º (revoga o art. 224 do CP)

readings.description: Yes, read through art. 217-A's 'vulnerável' (under 14, or unable to discern or resist), which absorbed the old art. 224 presumptions. Art. 9º would then add half when the victim is vulnerável.

note: The second reading applies a penal increase by analogy in malam partem and runs into CP art. 1º. The courts' position was not fetched; cite one before settling. The five bare 'Vide Lei nº 8.072' pointers (markers V34–V38, codigo-penal-1940.txt lines 1190, 1195, 1197, 1199 and 1201) point here.

question: When does payment of the social-security debt extinguish punishability for art. 168-A? Only before the ação fiscal begins (§ 2º), at any time (Lei 10.684/2003 art. 9º § 2º), or only for parcelled debts (Lei 9.430/1996 art. 83 § 4º, as amended in 2011)? And what is the effect of the LC 225/2026 carve-out for the devedor contumaz?

readings.description: Full payment by the related legal entity extinguishes punishability whenever made, per Lei 10.684 art. 9º § 2º, a statute outside the Code. Parcelamento suspends the pretensão punitiva (art. 9º caput). Neither applies to a declared devedor contumaz (art. 9º §§ 3º–4º, from LC 225/2026).

Only the Code's § 2º: spontaneous declaration, confession, payment and information 'antes do início da ação fiscal'. § 3º (perdão judicial or multa only) covers payment after the ação fiscal and before the denúncia.

Lei 9.430 art. 83 as amended by Lei 12.382/2011 (§§ 2º and 4º) is the later and more specific rule. Suspension requires a parcelamento requested before the denúncia is received, and extinction follows full payment of the parcelled debt. It excludes vedação legal and the devedor contumaz (§ 5º I–II).

note: Suggested because it is the widest statute in force and LC 225/2026 re-enacted its § 3º carve-out, which implies the legislator treats it as live. The courts' reconciliation of the two statutes, and how late payment may come, was not fetched. Encode extinction as a separate ground with its own inputs (pagamento integral; parcelamento vigente; devedor contumaz declarado), not by editing § 2º.

question: Does art. 150 apply to a public agent entering a home in the exercise of the function, given Lei 13.869/2019 art. 22? And how are 'noite' (§ 1º) and 'dia' (§ 3º I) measured?

readings.description: A public agent acting as such is punished under Lei 13.869 art. 22, which is special and later. The same law revoked art. 150 § 2º, which had covered officials. For warrant execution, 'dia' is the window 5h–21h (art. 22 § 1º III). For private persons 'noite' remains a judgement input.
Art. 150 applies to everyone. Lei 13.869 adds a crime for authorities without displacing art. 150. 'Dia/noite' are natural daylight and darkness for every purpose.

note: The encoder should keep 'a entrada ocorreu durante a noite' as an input fact. The 21h–5h window binds only warrant execution and must not be generalised to § 1º for private persons. No court ruling was fetched.

question: Does § 3º II ('quando algum crime está sendo ali praticado ou na iminência de o ser') require that a crime actually was being committed, or is entry lawful whenever founded reasons pointed to flagrante delito beforehand?

readings.description: Entry is lawful when, beforehand, founded reasons (justified afterwards) indicated flagrante delito inside. This follows STF Tema 280 for entries by agents and Lei 13.869 art. 22 § 2º ('fundados indícios').
The exclusion requires that a crime in fact was being committed or was imminent, as the text says.

note: Tema 280 is a constitutional thesis on CF art. 5º XI and evidence. Carrying it into the criminal exclusion is a reading. For private persons the textual reading may be the better fit, and the encoder may split the fork by the agent's status.

question: Are art. 151 caput and § 1º I still operative for postal correspondence, and § 1º IV for clandestine radio stations, or were they displaced by Lei 6.538/1978 art. 40 and Lei 9.472/1997 art. 183?

readings.description: Displaced by speciality or implied repeal: Lei 6.538 art. 40 for postal correspondence and Lei 9.472 art. 183 for clandestine telecommunications activity. Art. 151 governs only what those statutes do not cover.
Art. 151 stays fully operative, because neither statute expressly revokes it.

note: Encode art. 151 as written, with an input fact saying whether the object is postal correspondence or the conduct is a telecom activity, and REFUSE there rather than silently apply art. 151. No court ruling was fetched. Vide V7 (Lei 6.538) is sweep-a's marker.

question: What ação penal governs art. 129, on which the Code is silent?

readings.description: Lesão leve (caput) and culposa (§ 6º) need representação under Lei 9.099 art. 88. Where the lesão results from domestic and family violence against a woman, Lei 11.340 art. 41 disapplies Lei 9.099 and the action is pública incondicionada (STJ Súmula 542). All other forms are pública incondicionada by default.
The Code states no condition, so art. 100's default (pública incondicionada) governs every form of art. 129.

note: Open edge: § 9º against a victim who is not a woman (e.g. a brother), and § 13, which is not 'leve' in penalty. The encoder should decide there whether art. 88's 'lesões corporais leves' is about the injury or the penalty band, or REFUSE. STF ADI 4424, which reached the same result as STJ 542, was not fetched.

question: What is 'violência doméstica e familiar' in art. 121-A § 1º I, which the Code does not define?

readings.description: Lei 11.340 art. 5º's definition: a gender-based act in the domestic unit, the family, or any intimate relationship, 'independentemente de coabitação' (STJ Súmula 600).
The Code's own list in art. 129 § 9º (ascendant, descendant, sibling, spouse or partner, domestic worker, cohabitant, relations of hospitality).

note: The Lei 11.340 definition carries a 'baseada no gênero' element, which overlaps art. 121-A § 1º's 'razões da condição do sexo feminino'. The encoder should keep the two inputs distinct.

question: Do the immunities of arts. 181–182 apply to a Título II crime committed as patrimonial violence against a woman (Lei 11.340 art. 7º IV)? And does 'cônjuge' in art. 181 I reach a companheiro?

readings.description: The immunity subsists. Art. 183 lists the exceptions exhaustively (violence or grave threat against the person, a stranger taking part, a victim aged 60 or more), and Lei 11.340 created no new one.
The immunity is set aside where the crime is patrimonial violence against a woman under Lei 11.340 art. 7º IV, because of the state's duty to prevent such violence.

note: No court position was fetched; cite the STJ before settling. The companheiro question is an extension in bonam partem and belongs here as an extra reading once a citation is found. Art. 182 I after STF Tema 1053 is F-sweep-b-23.

question: Does reduction to a condition analogous to slavery require restriction of the victim's freedom of movement, or is each 'quer…' mode enough on its own?

readings.description: The modes are alternatives: forced labour, an exhausting working day, degrading conditions, or restriction of movement for debt. Restraint of movement is not required, but the violation must be intense and persistent.

citations.cite: STF Inq 3412, Tribunal Pleno, julgado em 29/03/2012 (via TST-RR-450-57.2017.5.23.0041)

readings.description: 'Condição análoga à de escravo' requires deprivation of liberty in every mode.

note: The fork is settled by M-sweep-b-19. 'Intensa e persistente' is a judgement input.

question: Does art. 140 reach an injúria whose motive is the victim's sexual orientation or gender identity, or is it displaced to Lei 7.716/1989 art. 2º-A (reclusão 2–5 anos) by the STF's ADO 26 / MI 4733?

readings.description: It is displaced: homotransphobic injúria is injúria racial under Lei 7.716 art. 2º-A, following the STF's extension of ADO 26 / MI 4733.

citations.cite: Lei 7.716/1989 art. 2º-A; Planalto heading '(Vide ADO Nº 26)'
STF ADO 26 / MI 4733 (and ED) — NOT fetched; STF unreachable 2026-09-29

readings.description: Art. 140 caput governs, because § 3º lists religion, age and disability only and art. 2º-A lists race, colour, ethnicity and national origin only.

citations.cite: CP art. 140 caput e § 3º; Lei 7.716/1989 art. 2º-A

note: The suggestion is provisional. It rests on the Planalto marker and on secondary reports, not on the STF text. The encoder should keep the question as an input and cite the STF decision before settling.

question: For a crime against the honour of a public servant because of the servant's functions, is the action only the MP's upon representação (art. 145 p.u.), or may the victim also bring a queixa?

readings.description: Concurrent: the victim may bring a queixa, or represent to the MP, which then brings a conditioned public action.
Only the MP, upon representação, as the text of art. 145 p.u. says.

note: The fork is settled by M-sweep-b-21. Whether the súmula also reaches the Presidents of the Senado, Câmara and STF, added to art. 141 II by Lei 14.197/2021, is left open. ADPF 338 (2026) upheld art. 141 II itself (M-sweep-b-44).

question: Does § 2º VI (emitting a cheque without funds, or frustrating its payment) require fraud? And what is the effect of paying the cheque before the denúncia is received?

readings.description: Fraud is an element (Súmula 246). Payment before the denúncia is received bars the action, while payment after it does not (Súmula 554 a contrario).
Issuing a cheque without funds completes the offence, and payment afterwards never matters.

note: The a contrario limb is the reading, not the súmula's words. Encode it as an input 'pagamento antes do recebimento da denúncia' leading to extinction, citing Súmula 554.

question: Is latrocínio consummated when the victim dies even though the subtraction is not completed?

readings.description: Yes. The death consummates latrocínio, even if nothing is taken.
Without the subtraction the complex crime is only attempted.

note: The fork is settled by M-sweep-b-23.

question: When is roubo consummated?

readings.description: When possession is inverted by violence or grave threat, even briefly and even with immediate pursuit and recovery.
Only when the agent has peaceful, unwatched possession.

note: The fork is settled by M-sweep-b-24.

question: Is extorsão consummated only when the undue economic advantage is obtained?

readings.description: No. It is consummated when the victim is constrained, whether or not the advantage is obtained.
Yes. Obtaining the vantagem is needed for consummation.

note: The fork is settled by M-sweep-b-25.

question: When is furto consummated?

readings.description: With de facto possession of the thing, even briefly and followed by pursuit (the amotio/apprehensio view).
Only with peaceful, unwatched possession.

note: The fork is settled by M-sweep-b-26.

question: Does the privilégio of § 2º (first offender, small value) combine with a qualified form of furto?

readings.description: Yes, if the qualifying circumstance is objective (e.g. breaking an obstacle, escalada, chave falsa, concurso). No, if it is subjective (abuso de confiança). § 8º allows it 'em qualquer caso' expressly.
No. § 2º sits before the qualified forms and applies only to simple furto, except where a provision says otherwise (§ 8º).

note: The encoder must classify each qualifying circumstance, including the 2025–2026 additions (§§ 4º-B, 5º, 6º, 7º, 9º, 10), which Súmula 511 predates. Where the classification is unclear, REFUSE.

question: Does the nocturnal increase of § 1º apply to furto qualificado?

readings.description: No. § 1º applies only to simple furto (caput). Night-time may weigh at the first phase of sentencing (art. 59).
Yes. The text of § 1º refers to 'o crime' without limiting it to the caput.

note: Tema 1087 was fixed on the pre-2026 § 1º and names § 4º only. Lei 15.397/2026 rewrote § 1º (metade) and multiplied the qualified forms. The currency risk is recorded on M-sweep-b-28. A divergent STF line is reported by secondary sources and was not fetched.

question: What is 'repouso noturno'?

readings.description: The period when the population withdraws to rest, judged case by case, requiring the calm of night that lowers vigilance or resistance. Whether the victims were asleep, and whether the place was a shop, street, empty house or vehicle, does not matter.
Only an inhabited dwelling whose occupants are resting.

note: It is an input fact decided by the judge. Item 1 of the thesis ('um terço') is superseded by Lei 15.397/2026 ('metade'), so take the fraction from the compiled § 1º.

question: When is a furto materially atypical under the princípio da insignificância?

readings.description: Judge-found, on the four STF vectors (HC 84.412): minimal offensiveness, no social dangerousness, very low reprovability, inexpressive injury. Restitution alone is not enough (STJ Tema 1205), and it is inapplicable in domestic violence against women (STJ Súmula 589). The encoding takes 'conduta materialmente insignificante (reconhecida pelo juiz)' as an input.

citations.cite: STF HC 84.412/SP (vectors, as reproduced by TJDFT)

readings.description: Computed: the thing is worth at most 10% of the minimum wage at the time of the facts and the agent is not a recidivist.

citations.cite: TJDFT Acórdão 1659805 (a local parameter, not binding)

note: The brief's 'judgement stays with the judge' rule suggests an input, not a number. The 10% figure is a rule of thumb in some state courts and has no statutory basis.

question: Does § 4º, which unlike its siblings says 'organização criminosa' without 'ultraviolenta' and 'condutas previstas' without naming a law, mean the same as the other Lei 15.358 provisions?

readings.description: Yes. Read systematically with arts. 121 § 2º-D, 155 § 9º, 157 § 4º and 159 § 5º, all inserted by the same Lei 15.358 art. 33: an ultraviolent criminal organisation, paramilitary group or private militia, acting in the context of or for the conducts of Lei 15.358 art. 2º.
Literal: any 'organização criminosa' (the general Lei 12.850/2013 concept, not fetched), with 'condutas previstas' meaning the extortion conducts of art. 158 itself. The result is a broader tripling.

note: The divergence is in the enacted law itself, not a compilation slip. It was verified against Planalto's text of Lei 15.358. The literal reading widens a penalty tripling, so the narrower reading also has the in dubio pro reo argument.

question: After STF Tema 1053 (judicial separation no longer exists as an institution), who is a 'cônjuge desquitado ou judicialmente separado' under art. 182 I?

readings.description: Only spouses whose status was already fixed: desquitados, and those separated by judicial decision before the thesis. Divorced spouses fall under neither art. 181 nor art. 182, so the action is public and unconditioned. Couples who split later without divorcing are still married and fall under art. 181 I.

citations.cite: STF Tema 1.053 (RE 1.167.478), thesis as reproduced by TJRJ

readings.description: As above, and also spouses separated by public deed (Lei 11.441/2007), whose status Tema 1053 preserves in the same breath as judicial separation.

citations.cite: STF Tema 1.053 ('separadas por decisão judicial ou escritura pública')

readings.description: Art. 182 I extends by analogy in bonam partem to divorced spouses, the functional successor of 'desquitado'. On this reading, representação is required.

note: No criminal decision applying Tema 1053 to art. 182 I was fetched. The 'escritura' reading turns on whether 'judicialmente' is read strictly. The encoder should take the separation status as an input fact and REFUSE for divorced spouses rather than pick silently. A knock-on for art. 181 I: de facto separated spouses may now keep the absolute immunity, since nothing new ends the 'sociedade conjugal' short of divorce. That is unverified.

question: Art. 147-A § 1º II increases perseguição by half when committed against a woman for reasons of her sex 'nos termos do § 2º-A do art. 121', a paragraph revoked on 10.10.2024. Does the increase still apply, and if so, by what definition?

readings.description: Not applicable. The increase depends on a definition that no longer exists. Re-pointing it to art. 121-A § 1º would apply a penal increase by analogy in malam partem (CP art. 1º). This is the view stated by the Senate committee rapporteur on PL 1.548/2023.

citations.cite: Senate CSP rapporteur (Sen. Eliziane Gama) on PL 1.548/2023, reported by Senado Notícias 10/12/2024

readings.description: Applicable, reading the reference as pointing to art. 121-A § 1º, where Lei 14.994 moved the same content. The element 'razões da condição de sexo feminino' is written into § 1º II itself, so the revoked paragraph was only its definition.

note: No court ruling was found either way. The first reading is suggested because of strict legality in penal increases. An encoder unwilling to take a side should REFUSE when § 1º II's facts are present, rather than compute either answer. PL 1.548/2023 would fix the text (M-sweep-b-47).
